title: Build Replay-Wide Structural Hard-Challenger Census
objective: Measure whether replay-wide one-second surface observations contain enough non-anchor structural transition clusters to support a later hard-challenger lifecycle comparison, without emitting final death facts or attribution.

executionContract.reasoningComplexity: High: the task must reuse the accepted Task 190 observation semantics across complete replay timelines, separate transition-cluster census from death truth, and preserve exact provenance, replay protection and denominator integrity.
executionContract.objective: Build pilot and bounded-32 replay-wide censuses of forward structural transition clusters outside Task 183 anchor windows, establishing only whether enough eligible challengers exist for a future specificity experiment.
technicalContext: Accepted Task 192 found only two eligible 30-second hard challengers because it was intentionally limited to the Task 190 matched-control observation surface.

Task 190 already samples controller and linked-pawn surfaces once per second across each replay before selecting anchor/control windows; those replay-wide mapped observations are not emitted as raw values.
A census of replay-wide structural clusters is the smallest useful next unit: it can determine feasibility before another lifecycle comparison is authorized.
confirmedState: Tasks 191 and 192 are accepted locally; the accepted Task 192 commit is 95248e632b5fc0b1bdcde796cc3646444da8c174.
Task 192 technical evidence is valid but its operational specificity assessment is insufficient, with two 30-second challenger pairs.
Origin publication remains externally blocked; origin/main still points to the rejected original Task 191 candidate and cannot be used as accepted state.
Final deaths, confirmed who-died claims, attribution, killer/victim, teamfight and gameplay interpretation remain unavailable.
branchEnvironment: Repository Gwen-Silva/deadem on local branch task191-correction.
Create exactly one Task 193 commit over the accepted local base; push only if a live remote ref can be verified, never modify origin/main or force-push.
allowedScope: Add a Task 193 census contract, strict schema, emitter, focused tests, pilot/bounded-32 artifacts, task/report and required navigation/state/index updates.

Perform a bounded no-behavior-change export/refactor in the Task 190 evidence tool only when necessary to reuse its one-second observation and participant-mapping semantics; all Task 190 regressions must remain exact.
Process only the accepted Task 190 pilot and bounded-32 manifests and their already authorized replay membership.
protectedAreas: Do not modify packages/deadem, packages/engine, samples, parser behavior, Task 180-192 historical outputs or accepted baselines.
Do not read, hash, copy, inspect, open or process replay_005, replay_006, replay_007 or replay_008.
Do not label any non-anchor cluster as a death, non-death, false death, confirmed negative or ground truth, and do not create Task 194.
expectedChanges: Derive replay-wide forward transition clusters from the same one-second controller/linked-pawn/link-relation surface observations used by Task 190, keyed by replay, synthetic participant and observed transition second.

Require immediate persistence, deduplicate family/surface observations into one structural cluster, exclude every Task 183 anchor window for the same participant, and emit 3/5/10-second exclusion sensitivity.

Emit replay and aggregate counts by follow-up horizon, family/surface opportunity, ambiguity, exclusion, provenance and reuse, plus a feasibility assessment separate from any lifecycle specificity or death claim.
acceptanceCriteria: Every census cluster is replay-sourced, uses the actual observed transition second, has immediate persistence, is outside every primary Task 183 anchor window and has unique replay/participant/second identity.

Pilot and bounded-32 membership, pre-open bridges, parser completion, participant mapping, protected replay count, source reuse, cluster reuse and denominators are independently auditable and fail closed.

The census reports 10/20/30/60/120/180-second eligibility and classifies feasibility as sufficient, limited or insufficient using declared count thresholds; it does not run or claim a new specificity comparison.
All final-fact, attribution and gameplay readiness fields remain false and the accepted Task 190/192 artifacts remain byte-identical.
requiredEvidence: Exact source manifest and accepted-gate bridges to Tasks 180, 183, 190 and 192 before replay-path resolution; parser completion and protected-access audits.

Per-replay and aggregate structural cluster counts, actual-second exclusion audit, immediate-persistence audit, family/surface composition, horizon eligibility, deduplication/reuse ledgers and feasibility thresholds.
Post-commit attestation with real SHA, base, branch, commit list, changed files, commands, tests, artifacts, limitations, push evidence and final VALIDATING status.
commitPolicy: Preserve the Work-authored accepted-state and Task 193 spec changes, stage only authorized Task 193 files and create exactly one commit.
Do not amend accepted Task 192, use any rejected candidate as a base, modify origin/main or claim a push without live remote SHA verification.
stopConditions: Stop before replay access on any base, branch, accepted-state, manifest, membership, provenance, bridge or protection mismatch.
Stop if replay-wide clusters cannot be derived from existing observation semantics without parser behavior changes, raw-value output, semantic guessing or weakening immediate persistence.
Stop on protected replay access, historical output mutation, source/cluster reuse, denominator mismatch, unexpected output warning, more than one commit or any final-fact/attribution claim.
returnReportFormat: Use every section in docs/codex/CODEX_REPORT_TEMPLATE.md and attach the post-commit attestation.
Report technical gate, census feasibility and publication status separately; final acceptance remains pending independent ChatGPT Work validation.

stopConditions: Never emit raw values, final death facts, negative ground truth or attribution.
Do not modify parser packages, accepted Task 190/192 outputs, origin/main or create Task 194.
Stop after the Task 193 handoff in VALIDATING.
